column1: # A flags array that names one KNOWN variant twice refuses the read `malformed`,
# as a repeated key does: a conforming writer writes each set bit's name once.
# An unknown name keeps its treatment, skipped and counted `unknown`; this
# corpus does not rule on an unknown name written twice, and a flags array
# inside a value the read only SKIPS is held to the JSON grammar alone.
#   unit     the schema directory the root belongs to, from the repository root
#   root     the table the text is read at
#   text     the JSON file, in this directory
#   unknown  the report's unknown count, or `-` where the row does not pin one
